original_test_intent: Verify BMC-side functional reachability across the named BMC I2C-3, FPGA1, FPGA1 EROT, HMC I2C-4 and HMC FRU path using the defined0x11 register transaction and component-specific response evidence.
original_method: Map logical BMC I2C-3 to Linux bus2 and identify address0x11/register0x0400 owner; define how its three-byte response represents FPGA1/EROT/HMC/FRU reachability; collect bus ownership/error baseline; avoid broad scanning; run one approved combined write-pointer/read; decode all fields against PID/vendor spec; correlate component logs/status and confirm no new bus errors.
manual_activity: BMC/HMC/platform owner supplies PID1114953 hop mapping,0x11 register protocol/decoder, access ownership and recovery. Physical probing/photos are not assumed as acceptance.
required_inputs: PID1114953 mapping from BMC I2C-3 to Linux bus2 through FPGA1/EROT to HMC I2C-4 and HMC FRU
Identity of bus2 address0x11 and proof it is the intended gateway/device
Vendor register definition for write bytes0x04 0x00 and three returned bytes, including expected values/masks
Explanation of which reply fields prove each named component/hop and any separate FRU content read needed
Bus owner/driver, safe combined-transaction and scan policy, timeout/NACK criteria
BMC/HMC recovery plus relevant FPGA/EROT/FRU status/error interfaces
safety_requirements: Do not run `i2cdetect -q` broadly without per-address safety approval
Confirm0x0400 is a non-mutating address-pointer/read operation for the exact0x11 device
Coordinate with driver/daemon ownership of bus2 and avoid forced or concurrent access
Execute one bounded transaction; stop on unexpected length/value, NACK, timeout, arbitration loss, stuck bus or management degradation
Do not infer all-hop health from ACK alone; preserve logs and verify components after the read
agent_execution_scope: Validate topology, address/register identity, ownership and read-only health/error baselines
After approval, run one bounded combined transaction and decode/correlate the exact three bytes
Do not probe/solder, scan blindly, write unknown registers/FRU, infer hop identity, reset components, auto-retry or decide verdict
engineer_actions: Approve hop-by-hop map and logical-to-Linux bus mapping
Approve0x11/0x0400 semantics, expected three-byte decoder and coverage per component
Approve access ownership, timeout/abort and recovery
Review decoded transaction plus component evidence and issue verdict

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use the exact approved combined read plus component-specific status/error evidence to validate each named hop without broad discovery.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds a register decoder, hop coverage model, ownership and error oracle and removes invented physical-only acceptance.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: An ACK or arbitrary three bytes from0x11 proves only a responder on bus2; it does not establish FPGA1 EROT, HMC I2C-4 or FRU participation unless the register meaning and path are documented.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Unknown register-pointer semantics or quick-write scans may alter devices; a gateway health register may not directly validate FRU content and may need a separate safe read.

project_override_considerations: Wistron I2C policy requires BMC controller, bus, target address, vendor protocol, expected response and OOB recovery. The command may run only after BMC I2C-3-to-bus2 and0x11 ownership are proven.

BMC, FPGA1, EROT, HMC and FRU identities plus bus owner/driver baseline
Vendor excerpt for0x11 register0x0400 and three-byte field decoder

engineering_decision_pending.question: Resolve Reliability row130 Wistron-HW Robust-00465-V004: provide PID1114953 hop mapping from BMC I2C-3/Linux bus2 through FPGA1/EROT to HMC I2C-4 and HMC FRU; identify0x11, define0x0400 combined-read semantics and the expected three-byte decoder proving each component, plus any separate FRU read. Approve/replace broad `i2cdetect -q`, define ownership, timeout/NACK criteria and recovery; confirm physical probing is not mandatory unless separately scoped.

review_improvement: Turns an invented physical-only verdict into a guarded register-level functional test and exposes that the supplied single reply needs a documented decoder and hop coverage model.
independent_technical_reasoning: A two-byte write followed by a three-byte read commonly behaves as a register-addressed query, but its safety and meaning are device-specific and cannot be assumed. The critical engineering question is whether register0x0400 at0x11 reports the actual downstream EROT/HMC/FRU path or only the local FPGA gateway. Therefore execution needs an authoritative decoder and supplementary component evidence, not continuity photos or a generic bus ACK.
